description: Authorized modifications to protected (baseline) surfaces and governance controls. Schema v2: every entry must be COMPLETE — id, phase, dates, requester {login,role}, rationale, risk, affected_functionality, new_functionality, regression_tests, evidence {summary,links}, changes[] with per-file content_sha256, and a structured tl_approval {approved:true, approver, date, decision_ref} whose approver is a baseline.governance.approvers login. A truthy tl_approval value alone is rejected by the governance gate. Entries that fail any schema check grant no authorization at all. Workers must not self-serve entries.

entries.rationale: Architect review (Phase A — repair governance): upgrade the M0 governance gate to v2. Hash-protected governance control files, complete authorization schema with content-bound hashes, tamper-rejection self-tests, workflow trust-anchor pin, CODEOWNERS and branch rulesets. The v1 gate accepted a truthy tl_approval field alone, which is insufficient.
entries.affected_functionality: Gamos governance gate only: verifier script, self-tests, re-baselining tool, protected-surfaces policy, authorization ledger, governance CI workflow, CODEOWNERS. No ZCode application surface is touched.
entries.new_functionality: scripts/gamos/governance-check.mjs v2 (control-file hash verification, trust-anchor pin, tag cross-check, authorization schema v2 with content binding); scripts/gamos/governance-self-test.mjs (13 tamper-rejection scenarios); scripts/gamos/governance-rebaseline.mjs (sanctioned re-baselining); workflow self-test job + daily schedule; CODEOWNERS + rulesets.

evidence.summary: Tamper-rejection suite: 13/13 scenarios behave as specified (unauthorized modification/deletion, missing protected file, modified baseline SHA, forged baseline without pin, weakened verifier, truthy-only approval, incomplete record, content drift, history rewrite rejected; pristine and complete-evidence control cases pass). GitHub Actions runs recorded in evidence/phase-a/ and docs/gamos/IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md.

tl_approval.decision_ref: gamos/development Phase-A governance-v2 commit; architect review directive 'Repair governance' items 1-4; evidence in docs/gamos/IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md#phase-a

Verifier refined to ledger supersession semantics (later complete authorizations supersede earlier stale content hashes); self-test extended to 14 scenarios.
entries.affected_functionality: Governance protected-surface policy only (adds new control files); no ZCode application surface touched.
entries.new_functionality: docs/gamos/contracts/01..09 frozen under baseline.controls; docs/gamos/workers/* briefs; authorization binding for the freeze.

evidence.summary: Contracts authored per architect Phase C list; frozen via governance-rebaseline; CI run recorded in IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.

tl_approval.decision_ref: architect review directive Phase C (freeze before workers) + Phase D (prepare workers); see docs/gamos/workers/tl-integration-plan.md

entries.rationale: Architect re-review of commit 80c002dd accepted the nine Phase-0 contracts as the initial design baseline subject to corrections A-E. This entry authorizes revision 1 of the affected contracts through the sanctioned re-baselining process: (A) explicit alignment with the existing PlayLiquid/GameIR source contracts (payswapdotorg/PlayLiquid-2.0 packages/playliquid-gameos/src/game-ir, pinned 196b305e) with no second independent GameIR; (B) capability registry fail-closed selection with the silent registry-order fallback removed and the full execution-safety record (provider identity, prerequisites, compatibility, reversibility, idempotency, timeout, cancellation, verification); (C) GamePlan orchestration mapped onto the existing ZCode Dynamic Workflow definition/compiler/runtime with database tables explicitly not a substitute; (D) UI plugin sandbox vs MCP server process execution distinction, trust/isolation model for external MCP processes, permission-gated native engine mutations, and repository-governance vs game-release/publishing authorization separation; (E) engine-specific version parsing and machine-local discovery data separated from shared project metadata. Decision recorded in docs/gamos/ADR/0005-phase0-contract-revision-and-phase-b-evidence.md.
entries.affected_functionality: Governance control documents only (docs/gamos/contracts/01,02,03,04,05,06,09). No ZCode application surface, no runtime code, no protected upstream file is touched. Baseline.controls hashes and the workflow trust anchor rotate via scripts/gamos/governance-rebaseline.mjs.
entries.new_functionality: Contract revision 1 content per corrections A-E; ADR-0005; worker-brief and ADR-index updates (additive docs); Phase B evidence tooling (scripts/gamos/phase-b-ui-journey.mjs, .github/workflows/gamos-phase-b-e2e.yml) referenced by ADR-0005 as additive, non-protected files.

evidence.summary: Revisions authored per the architect re-review directive (corrections A-E); ADR-0005 records the decision and the Phase B sandbox-floor/CI-ceiling evidence model; rebaseline rotates the trust anchor; CI evidence for the Phase B user journey is recorded in docs/gamos/IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md after the gamos-phase-b-e2e workflow runs.

tl_approval.decision_ref: Architect re-review 'Gamos-2.0 — Architect Re-review and M0 Closure Directive' section 2 (Revise the Phase-0 contracts, corrections A-E, via the approved governance authorization/re-baselining process); recorded as ADR-0005
